description: A Lamoi site's plan rules (serviceId from oma_waas_sites). preview (tier free|mini|pro|shop): what is over that lower plan (pages, posts, products, team members, with pages that are in menus marked) and whether the site's own storage blocks the move; status: the 7 day grace after a downgrade (deadline, what was drafted); form_entries: the last 50 form entries a Free site sent to your account. Writes need confirm: downgrade (tier, optional keep {pages, posts, products, users: [ids]} = what stays published; the rest become drafts after 7 days, oldest first, never the front page or privacy, terms, cart, checkout and account pages; team members over the limit lose sign-in and keep their content; nothing is deleted; refused while the site's own storage is over the lower plan), restore (republish what a downgrade drafted, after an upgrade), wake (wake a sleeping Free site).

action.description: preview (default, needs tier), status and form_entries are reads; downgrade, restore and wake need confirm.

keep.description: downgrade: the ids that stay published (from preview). Items you do not pick become drafts after 7 days, oldest first, never protected pages. The owner always stays.

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

tier.description: preview / downgrade: the plan to move to.

name: oma_waas_plan
title: Lamoi site plan
